map.输入作文文本，统计总字数、字符数与段落数等多维指标，便于对照字数要求与排版，适用: Input essay text to count total characters, character count and paragraph count as multi-dimensional metrics, for checking word requirements and layout; suitable for Chinese homework and exams.
map.字数统计：中文字与英文词分别计。: Word count: Chinese characters and English words counted separately.
map.段落标点：统计段落与标点数。: Paragraph punctuation: count paragraphs and punctuation marks.
map.：示例：一段 300 汉字 + 50 英文词，分别计数字。: : example: a segment of 300 Chinese characters + 50 English words, counted separately.
map.中英文怎么算？: How to count Chinese and English?
map.中文按字、英文按词（空格分词）分别统计。: Chinese is counted by character, English by word (space-tokenized), counted separately.
